metric_scope: RV-007-compatible: first-occurrence document ranking from final Top-5 chunks

latency.note: Cached 20-candidate scores do not measure a live 5-candidate run.

methodology.fixed_top5: Sort the same five baseline chunks by cached reranker score.
methodology.tie_breaker: Stable order inside the original baseline band.
methodology.exploratory_design: The prefix restriction was added after observing fixed_top5 Recall@3 regression.
limitations: Same 13-question development set; no independent validation.
The constrained policy prevents positions 4-5 from reaching positions 1-3.
Preserved document IDs do not prove complete or authoritative passage evidence.
Cached logits can differ slightly from a future live batch configuration.
